title: Preparing for surgery
summary: Questions to discuss with your surgeon and chosen hospital.

blocks.text: Use these questions as a starting point for a conversation with your treating team.

sections.heading: Questions to ask your treating team

items: What procedure is being considered, and what are the alternatives?
Which hospital-specific preparation instructions should I follow?
Who should I contact if I need to clarify the plan?

blocks.text: Follow the individual instructions provided by your treating team.
